title: TABLECONTENT column, row, and cell style-ID capture and domain gate

spec_basis.document: Open Design Specification for .dwg files v5.4.1
spec_basis.correction: TABLECONTENT has numeric base-style IDs for columns, rows, and cells. Table-level style is an override payload plus a TABLESTYLE handle; it is not a fourth numeric style ID.
spec_basis.domain: 0 means no base style; 1-3 are built-in styles; 4 is R24/AC1024+ built-in; custom IDs start at 101. Other signed values are retained but make semantic content incomplete.

scope: add signed 32-bit base-style ID fields to DRW_TableColumn and DRW_TableRow; retain the already parsed DRW_TableCell ID
read each numeric ID through the existing bounded BL parser in both AC1021 standalone TABLECONTENT and AC1024+ embedded TABLECONTENT routes
fail soft on out-of-domain IDs: preserve structural parse and ID observation while marking semantic content incomplete
correct the RPP-5x plan and receipt language that incorrectly described a fourth table-level numeric ID
generated_controls: AC1021 valid custom column/cell IDs and common built-in row ID
AC1021 refusal of R24-only ID 4, reserved ID 5, and negative IDs without structural parse failure
AC1024 acceptance of built-in ID 4, custom ID 101, and built-in ID 3
AC1024 refusal of reserved and negative IDs while withholding the incomplete typed snapshot at the optional-content boundary
existing AC1021/AC1024 TABLECONTENT reference-role vectors remain passing

scoped_diff_check.command: git diff --check -- src/drw_entities.h src/drw_entities.cpp tests/dwg_object_vectors_tests.cpp CMakeLists.txt DWG_DXF_OPEN_SOURCE_PARITY_PLAN.md docs/research/rpp5y-tablecontent-style-id-capture-domain-fast-slice-2026-10-22.json

next: The RPP-5z bounded adapter-preflight census is implemented. Keep DXF output fail-closed because Autodesk's published TABLE DXF schema has no base-style-ID slots; continue with native DWG TABLE writing or another locally representable TABLESTYLE/CELLSTYLEMAP implementation slice.
